question: Is ATT&CK technique T1078.001 (Default Accounts) covered by a Sigma rule in the cloud rule corpus? Investigate and give your conclusion.
final_answer: COVERED - The technique T1078.001 (Default Accounts) is not directly tagged in any rule, but it is covered by a rule that is tagged for its parent technique T1078.
